method: A7-N independently read each proposal's mechanism (state variable, transform, sign claim, controls) and mapped it against EVERY class in forbidden_family_inventory.json WITHOUT trusting the lanes' self-checks; lane self-checks were then inspected and each class verdict is marked agree / disagree / lane_disclosed_adjacency. INELIGIBLE_FORBIDDEN_VARIANT is reserved for proposals that ARE a variant/inversion/renaming/parameter-rescue of a listed row.

per_class_legend.CLEAN: no mechanism element touches the class
per_class_legend.ADJACENT_WITH_GUARDS: economically adjacent neighborhood or an unresolved empirical-correlation channel; preregistered guards exist and are recorded; not a variant/rescue of the listed row
per_class_legend.NOT_RUN_GUARD: the proposal declares a binding A7-N rho gate vs ranks that do not exist as measurable panels in this cycle's inputs; the guard is disclosed NOT_RUN, never passed by silence

BASISLV-PREMFADE.overall_reason: Mechanism is a cross-sectional LEVEL fade of the 28d mean perp-vs-index premium. Distinct observable from every rejected family (price-gap from the /futures/data/basis route; no return, volume, OI, funding or distribution-moment term anywhere in the signal). Two adjacency channels are honestly declared by the lane and independently confirmed by A7-N: (i) V6/V1-CARRY-FUNDING - a persistent premium level mechanically implies persistent positive funding, so the fade ordering neighbors the V6 carry world; guards (price-only failure clause, inverted control firing on the carry world) are preregistered and adequate in design, but the declared binding rho gate vs the frozen V6 CARRY-3D / REVERSE-3D ranks is NOT_RUN because no V6 rank panel exists among this cycle's measurable inputs; (ii) V4/V8R - premium level correlates mechanically with recent price appreciation, so the rank may empirically neighbor momentum/reversal orderings; the lane accepts this as a binding gate; A7-N marks it NOT_RUN (no ancestor panel measurable in V14). Neither channel makes the proposal a variant, inversion, renaming or parameter rescue of a listed row.

OICH.overall_reason: A declared shadow-region entry (plan Section 1.1). NOT a forbidden variant: the feature is the second moment of the DAILY OI path (std of the 28 most recent daily log changes) while the V12 ancestor's feature is the two-point cumulative FIRST moment ln(OI_T/OI_(T-28d)); no window choice of a dispersion statistic reproduces a two-point endpoint ratio, and the ancestor's inversion (long growing OI) is not expressible as a churn sort. All six Section 1.1 front-door items are present and compliant (own mechanism; +0.758 disclosure; confirmatory status in verdict and denominator; own falsification control CTL-PRICEVOL containing zero OI quantity; D2 decorrelation gate accepted as binding; no gate relaxation). A7-N MEASURED the gate: rho vs the recomputed OILEV-V2-28D-FLOW-W anchor feature ranks +0.0471, vs the inverted control -0.0471 (|rho| identical by the pure-sign-flip symmetry), n=988 - PASS with wide margin.
